summary: P2, evidence gap. The two live Checks are only half met. Publish dry run 44312231152 picked build-native 44308449917 (find and verify pass, no cargo). The run then concluded failure: all four smoke-binary jobs failed at release-smoke.sh `canon gate check`, because the ledger at c55d95011 had no evidence after the approval. The publish job, with its five (dry-run) steps, was skipped. Reject run 44312805333 gave tree_mismatch, not no_run. Its recovery leg (build-native 44312929087 on scratch/0.44-no-run) lost the macOS row to cancellation, so `gh run rerun --failed` never passed. Fix: on the 0.44.0 release PR, record one green publish dry run end to end (publish job included). Blast radius: the publish job and smoke-install are unchanged by this patch, but no run has yet exercised them with fetched binaries.
